Dear Member:

Cascade Mutual has completed a level of care review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted, we have issued an adverse determination of level of care, inpatient versus observation. The billed inpatient level of care is not certified. The record supports that the services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

Basis for Determination

This review was conducted using the plan's adopted MCG-style criteria set. The following guideline codes were reviewed and found not met:

SEP-02: Antibiotic therapy could have been given in an outpatient or observation setting.

SEP-03: There was no evidence of new organ dysfunction.

Claim Adjustment Codes

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

This notice addresses the level of care billed only. It is not a statement regarding the medical appropriateness of the treatment rendered, and it does not address any other component of the claim.

Appeal Rights

You, your authorized representative, or the treating facility may submit a written appeal of this level of care determination. Written appeals must be addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on the reverse of this notice.

To support reconsideration, the appeal should reference each guideline code listed above and respond specifically to the finding stated for that code. For SEP-02, address the finding that antibiotic therapy could have been given in an outpatient or observation setting. For SEP-03, address the finding that there was no evidence of new organ dysfunction. Submit the complete medical record for the admission dated [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]], including physician orders and progress notes relied upon.

The appeal must include the following physician attestation line, signed by the attending or reviewing physician:

"I attest that the clinical information submitted in support of this appeal is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge." ______________________________

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be eligible for review.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
